messages:
maya: FYI customer Tangleback saw a 10–12m isolation during a peering maintenance window. Frontend failed over to hosted but SLA degraded.

 tom: Can you drop the LB/health snippets? sounds like classic PMTU/ICMP issue we saw earlier.

 maya: LB: `2026-03-23T03:12:08Z tangle-prod lb1 ERROR conn_reset reason=icmp_frag_needed` 
health: `2026-03-23T03:12:15Z tangle-prod healthcheck FAIL code=504 route=peer-eu`

 sylvia: I'll pull BGP/flow logs. Quick hypothesis: onprem firewall dropping ICMP + our flap damping causing withdraws.

 maya: Proposed short action list (owners + dates):
- A1: Verify customer firewall allows PMTU ICMP types (owner: sylvia) due 2026-03-27
- A2: Add MTU/ICMP probe to Tangle onboarding and alert on `peer.icmp_unreach_count` spike (owner: tom) due 2026-03-30
- A3: Add a 2m dedicated-pool fallback before full hosted fallback in the peering runbook/policy (owner: maya) due 2026-03-29
- A4: Assign recurring-pattern owner and start monthly peering regression triage (owner: ops) due 2026-04-05

 sylvia: Starting A1; requested temporary access from customer to check firewall rules and run test probe. Flow logs uploaded to ticket.

 ops-bot: Created follow-ups: https://redwood-internal/tasks/TANGLE-POST-2777770000 (A1,A2,A3,A4).

 maya: We'll reconvene next Mon 09:00 to check progress. Owners: update tasks when you begin. If blockers, ping here. :white_check_mark:
